headline: Law directs the National Park Service to study whether Lahaina, Hawaii, should become a National Heritage Area.
what_it_does: This law tells the National Park Service to study whether it makes sense to designate Lahaina, in Maui County, Hawaii, as a National Heritage Area. The study will look at whether the area is suitable and whether the designation is practical. The law does not create the heritage area itself; that would require a later decision.

who_it_affects.group: Residents and communities of Lahaina, Maui County, Hawaii
who_it_affects.how: Their town will be reviewed for possible designation as a National Heritage Area under the National Heritage Areas Act.
The agency must carry out the study of Lahaina's suitability and feasibility as a heritage area.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 23, 2024; the summary does not give a deadline for the study.
